landing.headline: Profipaws
landing.subtitle: Full app access for a one-time €20 payment. Try the free demo before you buy.
landing.demoFailed: Could not open the demo. Please try again.
landing.demoHint: Try the app with sample data, free. About 60 minutes; changes reset when you enter again.
landing.maintenanceBanner: Site under development — public access is closed.
landing.maintenanceSubtitle: We're building the digital health passport for pets. Public access is closed for now.
landing.maintenanceLoginDenied: Access is unavailable while the site is under development.
landing.loginFailed: Could not sign in with Google. Please try again.
landing.loginSubtitle: Sign in with Google to save and view your pets' health records.
landing.loginSecure: Secure sign-in. We never post anything on your behalf.
landing.featureClinicalDesc: Vaccines, surgeries, exams, and documents in one place.
landing.featureVetDesc: A 6-digit code or a scannable code at the clinic — no account needed for the vet.
landing.featureB2bDesc: Clinics can view and update the history using the pet's microchip.
landing.ownersSubtitle: Record, track, and share your pets' health without scattered paperwork.
landing.featPetsDesc: With full access, register as many pets as you want. One passport per animal.
landing.featHistoryDesc: Vaccines (name, brand, code/serial, dates, notes), diseases, surgeries, exams, and treatments.
landing.featFollowUpDesc: Consultations with doctor, reason, treatment, and later evolution notes.
landing.featWeightDesc: Log dated measurements and see recent progress at a glance.
landing.featCalendarDesc: Appointments, vaccines, and medicines scheduled per pet.
landing.featAlertsDesc: Upcoming vaccines and reminders when you open the app and on the profile.
landing.featPassDesc: A short document to show vaccination status to a vet or wherever it's requested.
landing.featShareDesc: Invite other users with read or edit access.
landing.featPinDesc: A temporary code or a scannable code so the vet can open the record without an account.
landing.featExportDesc: Download the full history, a data backup, and reminder emails with full access.
landing.clinicsSubtitle: Fast access during visits and connection with the clinic's software when they use microchips.
landing.featClinicAccessDesc: With the owner's access code, the vet opens the passport instantly.
landing.featApiDesc: The clinic can view and add history data using the pet's microchip.
landing.featDossierDesc: Download a file with the full passport to use in the clinic's system.
landing.howSubtitle: Three steps to have the passport ready when you need it.
landing.step1Desc: Sign in with Google and register your pets in seconds.
landing.step2Desc: Vaccines, weight, consultations, and reminders in one place.
landing.step3Desc: Vaccine certificate, vet access code, or share with whoever cares for your pet.
landing.ctaBottomSubtitle: One payment, no subscription. Want to try first? Open the free demo.
